ability.name: Mean 'Un
ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with this unit's **Companion** weapons.

ability.name: Sneaky 'Un
ability.effect: This unit can use the 'Normal Move' or 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **^^Retreat^^** abilities this phase.

ability.name: Tough 'Un
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit.
